posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked: Yeah, I'll wait to see what people want to do if stuff changes during the round. For example, if one player is last in the Initiative order, chances are that whatever they wanted to attack at the start of the round may not be there at the end. But I can tell them "By the time it's your go, this guy will have moved up, these guys will have attacked you, and <fellow PC> will have tried to nuke that pair of bad guys over there", because even though I won't have actually done any rolling or writing at that point, I know what the enemies will have tried to do and can also say what the other player has told me of their plans. I stick to Initiative order so if the players happen to be adjacent in that order it makes things easier because I can just make my one-round post go from the end of their previous turns to the start of whichever of them is going first, rather than posting the start-to-finish of each round. Since I only have two players, this has a reasonable chance of happening ;). But we've had about two or three combats in the two or three years I've been running this on RPOL so I don't need to worry about it that often ;).
